title: Studio's Delegated Admin Scope editor can write an `adminScope` the spec rejects — toggling any switch before naming a business unit
body:
Found while burning down objectui#7265's `@object-ui/app-shell` ledger entries. ⚠️ Behaviour is IDENTICAL before and after that change — binding the editor's local type to the spec's is what made the divergence legible, it did not create it. Not fixed there, because it is a behaviour question and that slice was a type-binding one.

## The defect

`PermissionAdvancedFacets.tsx` materializes the Delegated Admin Scope facet from `asObject(draft.adminScope)` and patches it key by key:

```ts
const setScope = (patch) =>
  setDraft((p) => ({ ...p, adminScope: { ...asObject(p.adminScope), ...patch } }));
```

Every control in the section calls that. So flipping **Include subtree** (or any of the three manage-* switches) *before* typing a business unit writes `adminScope: { includeSubtree: true }` into the draft — an object `@objectstack/spec/security`'s `AdminScopeSchema` refuses, because `businessUnit` is the one REQUIRED key and the other five are `z.ZodDefault`.

## The failing probe, named

Against the resolved pin (`@objectstack/spec` 17.4.0):

```js
import { AdminScopeSchema } from '@objectstack/spec/security';

AdminScopeSchema.safeParse({ includeSubtree: true }).success;
// => false — issues: [{ code: 'invalid_type', path: ['businessUnit'] }]

// positive control, same schema, same call:
AdminScopeSchema.safeParse({ businessUnit: 'bu_sales' }).success;  // => true
```

The editor has no client-side parse of this facet before Save — a repo-wide grep for `adminScope` finds no validation between `setScope` and the whole-record Save — so the rejection lands as a server error on a record the author may have edited for other reasons entirely.

## The wrinkle that makes it hard to self-diagnose

The section's own summary badge reads:

```ts
count={scope.businessUnit || (scope.assignablePermissionSets?.length ?? 0) ? 1 : 0}
```

With `businessUnit` unset and no assignable sets that is `0`. So after toggling a switch the collapsed facet says **nothing is configured here**, while the draft now carries an `adminScope` that blocks the whole record from saving. The author is pointed away from the section that caused it.

## Not prescribing the fix

Several shapes are defensible and the choice is the maintainer's — prune the key when it reduces to a scope with no `businessUnit`; disable the dependent controls until one is named; validate the facet client-side and surface the error in the section; or make the badge count any non-empty scope so the section at least points at itself. Filed rather than fixed for that reason.

## Provenance

Filed by the `domain:ui` dev seat working the `@object-ui/app-shell` slice of objectui#7265 (that card stays open; this is not part of it). Dedup ran one targeted semantic search with a lit control in the same minute — the control returned 2 hits including a closed card, this subject returned 0.
